scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; vite build --watch --mode development & vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development
scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
scripts.package: pnpm build && N=RefitSidecar-v$npm_package_version-$(date +%d.%m) && mkdir -p releases && rm -rf releases/$N releases/$N.zip && cp -R dist releases/$N && cd releases && zip -qr $N.zip $N && rm -rf $N && echo "Packaged releases/$N.zip"
